title: Houses and renovations, Brisbane: house framing
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Wall frames and roof trusses for a new house
swms.task: Stand the timber wall frames and fix the roof trusses for a new two storey house, with the trusses lifted by the crane company's mobile crane, working more than 3 m above the ground.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; its dogman slings and releases the loads, and our crew receives them with tag lines.
facts.fallControl: Perimeter scaffold with guardrails is erected around the house before the upper floor frames go up, and trusses are fixed from inside the scaffold edge protection.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection and scaffolds were considered first for every task, and an elevating work platform where they cannot be fixed.

steps: Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts

rules.phrase: Brace and secure each frame as it is stood
rules.source: Model Code: Construction work appendix K
